Callout.Name: Drunk and Disorderly
Callout.Message: Drunk male shouting at passers-by outside a bar.
Callout.Advisory: No violence yet, staff want him moved on.

Script.Line: I am not drunk. I have had a few. I am not drunk.
They threw me out and I have been stood here since.
I am going home. Just let me go home.

Lines.Approach: No violence, they just want him moved on. He has other ideas.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
